## 3. Ключевые конфигурационные файлы
### configs/llm_routing.yaml
```yaml
roles:
  Maintainer:
    providers: [openai_gpt5_via_codex, gemini_25_pro, qwen_code, stub]
    reasoning_effort: high              # GPT-5
    extended_thinking: true             # Claude Opus
    adaptive_thinking: true             # Gemini 2.5
    json_mode: json_schema
    json_schema_ref: "configs/schemas/maintainer.intent.schema.json"
    timeout_sec: 45
  Architect:
    providers: [anthropic_opus41, openai_gpt5_via_codex, gemini_25_pro, qwen_code, stub]
    reasoning_effort: high
    extended_thinking: true
    adaptive_thinking: true
    json_mode: json_schema
    json_schema_ref: "configs/schemas/architect.plan.schema.json"
    timeout_sec: 60
  Dev:
    providers: [qwen_code, gemini_25_flash, openai_gpt5_mini, stub]
    reasoning_effort: minimal
    json_mode: off                      # код/текст; парсеры локальные
    timeout_sec: 30
  QA:
    providers: [qwen_code, openai_gpt5_mini, gemini_25_flash, stub]
    reasoning_effort: minimal
    json_mode: json_object
    json_schema_ref: "configs/schemas/qa.report.schema.json"
    timeout_sec: 30
  Scribe:
    providers: [qwen_code, openai_gpt5_mini, stub]
    reasoning_effort: minimal
    json_mode: json_object
    json_schema_ref: "configs/schemas/scribe.changelog.schema.json"
    timeout_sec: 25

# --- Global routing options ---
fallback:
  on: ["TIMEOUT", "RATE_LIMIT", "RC_NONZERO", "JSON_PARSE_ERROR"]
  strategy: "next_provider_then_resume"
  resume_after_hours: 5                 # лимиты Opus 4.1 обновляются ~каждые 5 ч
budgets:
  role_daily_tokens:
    Maintainer: 900
    Architect: 1800
    Dev: 1400
    QA: 800
    Scribe: 800```
